svg.title: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current: provisional reported dimensions
svg.desc: About 3500 kilometres reported branch length and about 40 kilometres local annual mean flow width at Svinøy. Separate spatial supports. Publisher-indexed prose only; original acquisition and identity admission pending. No seasonal range or geographic route is drawn.
